metadata.acceptance_notes: The sweep driver derives router_component_r6__<param_hash> for every point, stages each linked result.json, and rejects status=ok rows missing finite critical_path_ns, die_area, or total_power_mw. Require live full-width router state and at least one timing-feasible physical row; preserve explicit failed or incomplete rows only as boundary evidence. Treat PPA as router-plus-boundary-harness evidence, not aggregate mesh or workload energy.
